systems.name: Ubuntu Touch
systems.notes: Official port (miatoll). Needs the stock Android 10 firmware underneath.

systems.name: postmarketOS
systems.notes: Unsupported variant: needs a U-Boot match patch and upstream tqftpserv. No charger driver (slow charging). The ultrawide (GC8034 units) and macro cameras work, with an excalibur device tree, a qcom-camss fix and a ported GC8034 driver (camera/). Call audio untested.
